title: Perennial mutex ownership transfer
summary: The Goose mutex specifications transfer the protected Iris proposition to the holder on acquisition and require it back, together with the lock ownership token, on release.

source.statement: Lemma wp_Mutex__Lock lk R : {{{ is_lock lk R }}} Mutex__Lock lk {{{ RET #(); locked lk ∗ R }}}.

assumptions: The statement is in the Goose-language proof section with heapGS Σ and lock namespace N; R is an iProp Σ. The companion wp_Mutex__Unlock requires is_lock lk R ∗ locked lk ∗ ▷ R and returns True.

license.attribution: Tej Chajed; repository owner and pinned commit author

reuse: Import Perennial.goose_lang.lib.lock.lock in the pinned repository. Establish is_lock lk R for the lock invariant, then apply wp_Mutex__Lock to obtain locked lk and R. The paired wp_Mutex__Unlock closes the invariant when given locked lk and ▷ R. These lemmas use the enclosing Goose language and Iris proof-mode context.
